subject: Unable to Access Output met files, missing data

messages.author: 2857a36d0d07bb2f
messages.subject: Unable to Access Output met files, missing data
parts:
Hello, 

I have 2 questions. 

First is an error that I get in reading the output file that is created by GGIR, potentially for permission denied, in which the first two commands for permission in part 1 are yes. 

Checking that user has read access permission for all files in data directory: Yes
Checking that user has write access permission for directory specified by argument outputdir: Yes

Report part 2

1 2 3 4Error in g.report2: Struggling to read: C:/Users/jmcl224/Desktop/HannaActivity/NewOutputData//output_NewData/meta/ms2.out/Error in abs(diff(r)) : non-numeric argument to mathematical function

In addition: Warning message:

In readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :

  cannot open compressed file 'C:/Users/jmcl224/Desktop/HannaActivity/NewOutputData//output_NewData/meta/ms2.out/', probable reason 'Permission denied'

Second, we are missing days in the part 2 and part 5 day summaries that we know have recorded viable data from the ActiLife software, where we record our step counts and wear time. How can I access/recover this data from GGIR to get the MVPA data?

Thanks.
Alexa

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Unable to Access Output met files, missing data
parts:
1. Try to investigate in what file the error occurs and whether you can generate the report without including this file (you will need to remove the corresponding RData file from the meta/ms2.out folder).
2. You can do this by changing the GGIR day inclusion criteria. Probably ActiLife uses by default lighter criteria (> 10) for day inclusion than GGIR does (> 16 hours).

Vincent
